description: Three helper/main functions each contain one fault: a stray '@' (lexical), a missing ';' (syntax) and an undeclared 'tot' (semantic).
injected_faults: line 4: stray character '@' after 'return n * n;' in square()
line 8: missing ';' at the end of 'int result = n * n * n' in cube()
line 19: 'tot' is not declared in main (the variable is called 'total')
notes: The PRD F1 acceptance program: one error per phase in three different functions, so three roots are expected. warnings is empty because there are syntax roots. Fixing all three lines makes the program valid.
